description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'TimesheetActionLogSearchFilterParams' for filtering search parameters related to timesheet action logs within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It extends a base FilterParams class and specifies allowed sorting fields with a default sort field.

classes.name: TimesheetActionLogSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filter parameters for timesheet action logs, including allowed sorting fields and default sorting behavior.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params with default sort field 'timesheetActionLog.date'.
